rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Lady
rows.Bloom: Pink. Mild to strong fragrance. 35 petals. Medium, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Compact, upright. Large, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden.
